messages:
oliver: Heads-up: customer reported being throttled and then billed extra after a streaming request that included a toolcall. seems like the toolcall tokens were counted twice in provisional.
maya: interesting. is that stream vs toolcall attribution or a retry duplication?
oliver: logs attached. sequence: stream emits prefix -> toolcall happens (we credit toolcall tokens separately) -> client reconnects while toolcall result streaming back -> resumed stream includes the toolcall result tokens inline and sampler logs them again. aggregator sums stream tokens + toolcall tokens. ledger dedupes based on toolcall_id later but provisional quota check already fired.
tony: can you paste minimal logs?
oliver:```
[11:05:02.100] sample sess=custA prefix_tokens=48 stream_cost=0.0288
[11:05:02.210] toolcall id=tc-889 tokens=32 toolcall_cost=0.0192 credited_toolcall=true
[11:05:02.305] network: reconnect detected, resume-offset=48
[11:05:02.310] sample sess=custA resumed_stream_includes_tool_output tokens=32 stream_cost=0.0192 (duplicate)
[11:05:32.700] ledger commit sess=custA confirmed_stream_tokens=48 confirmed_toolcall_tokens=32 dedupe_toolcall=true adjustment=-32
```
maya: so aggregator provisional_total = 48+32+32 = 112 tokens until ledger adjustment drops one of the toolcall counts. That inflated provisional_cost and tripped quota.
eli: do we credit toolcall tokens into the same bucket as stream tokens? historically toolcalls were separate to avoid this but sampler currently tags both with session id and our aggregator doesn't attribute toolcall_id so it treats them as distinct increments.
tony: short-term: change quota enforcement to ignore provisional increments that are tagged as "toolcall" if a matching toolcall_id already exists in the provisional buffer for that session. basically dedupe by toolcall_id in aggregator. Low-risk.
oli: (ops-bot) created ticket ENG-4210 "Provisional dedupe: toolcall_id awareness" assigned @eli P1.
oli: also recommend we show a small "provisional pending" badge in console for requests that have toolcalls, to set expectation.
maya: long-term: aggregator should retain toolcall_id in samples and compute union(stream_tokens, toolcall_tokens) per session so duplicates are never double-counted. also ledger should emit a provisional_hint event when it intends to dedupe so UI can reflect pending adjustment.
billing-bot: NOTE: billing will continue to only bill ledger confirmed amounts. provisional spikes do not equal final charges.
tony: tests: add unit tests for stream+toolcall+reconnect flow and an e2e that verifies quota never fires when ledger later dedupes.
eli: implementation plan: 1) sampler attaches toolcall_id to toolcall samples; 2) aggregator keeps a small per-session LRU of recent toolcall_ids and ignores duplicates for provisional calc; 3) add a console banner when aggregator drops duplicates so CS can see root cause; 4) consider emitting a tentative_dedupe flag to UI when ledger's commit indicates a future adjustment.
maya: ops ask: ASAP hotfix for aggregator dedupe by toolcall_id and console tooltip explaining provisional semantics.
oliver: ok, I'll triage ENG-4210 and ship the aggregator hotfix branch today. will post PR link here.
ops-bot: BI ticket created BI-12121 "CS blurb: provisional double-count with toolcalls" assigned @maya.
eli: adding unit tests now. will coordinate with QA for e2e.
tony: thanks all. leaving thread open until PR is merged and CS message sent.
